// Blood II's object effects, which Mod\ObjectFX.txt changes.  GENERATED by
// `testBlood2Tables --dump objectfx` from Blood2/Shared/BloodModObjectFX.cpp;
// do not edit, regenerate.
//
// An object effect is one particle system the client fills in code per
// detail level (ClientShellDLL/ObjectFX.cpp, CObjectGeneralFX::CreateObject).
// A section names an effect, with _HIGH, _MEDIUM or _LOW for one level:
//
//     [FLAMING_2_HIGH]
//     Particle = "SpriteTextures\flames1_09.dtx"
//
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModObjectFX.h has the rest.

// The keys, the create struct's members without their type letter.  A key
// replaces that field of retail's recipe; Replace = TRUE starts from an
// empty one.  Retail's recipes are code (ClientShellDLL/ObjectFX.cpp):
//     Offset  vector <x, y, z>
//     RampUpTime  number, 0 or more
//     RampDownTime  number, 0 or more
//     Duration  number, 0 or more
//     AddDelay  number, 0 or more
//     Radius  number, 0 or more
//     Gravity  number
//     Rotations  vector <x, y, z>
//     PosRadius  number, 0 or more
//     EmitType  an emit type
//     NumParticles  whole number, 0 or more
//     Density  number, 0 or more
//     Alpha  number, 0 or more
//     MinColor  vector <x, y, z>
//     MaxColor  vector <x, y, z>
//     MinVelocity  number
//     MaxVelocity  number
//     MinLifetime  number, 0 or more
//     MaxLifetime  number, 0 or more
//     RampUpType  ramp flags
//     RampDownType  ramp flags
//     FXFlags  particle flags
//     Particle  a sprite texture
//
// Emit types: LOCATION RING SPHERE CYLINDER FILLEDRING FILLEDSPHERE FILLEDCYLINDER COMETTAIL POWERRING
// Ramp flags (RampUpType, RampDownType), joined by |: ALPHA VELOCITY NUMPARTICLES ROTATION POSRADIUS
// Particle flags (FXFlags), joined by |: REMOVESTOPPED RAMPDOWNSTOPPED MOVINGSOURCE MOVINGSTREAM ROTATINGSOURCE ALIGNROTATION SMOOTHSTOP STREAMING FREEROTATION ALL
//
// The effects, a section each, with _HIGH, _MEDIUM or _LOW for one detail
// level (ObjectParticles 2 or more, 1, 0):
//     SMOKETRAIL_1
//     SMOKETRAIL_2
//     FIRETRAIL_1
//     FIRETRAIL_2
//     FIRETRAIL_3
//     SPARKS_1
//     SPARKS_2
//     SPARKS_3
//     SINGULARITY_1
//     SINGULARITY_2
//     SINGULARITY_3
//     VOODOO_1
//     VOODOO_2
//     VOODOO_3
//     VOODOO_4
//     VOODOO_5
//     VOODOO_6
//     HEAL_1
//     SHIELD_1
//     SMOKING_1
//     SMOKING_2
//     SMOKING_3
//     FLAMING_1
//     FLAMING_2
//     FLAMING_3
//     GROUNDFLAME_1
//     GROUNDFLAME_2
//     STAFFTRAIL_1
//     STAFFTRAIL_2
//     STAFFTRAIL_3
//     BUGSPRAY_1
//     BUGSPRAY_2
//     ORBTRAIL_1
//     ORBTRAIL_2
//     ENERGYWALL_1
//     POWERUP_1
